scope.selection: Exactly all 38 country ideas in the native zzz_AET_ideas.txt, including every tier. No advisors, designers, focuses or three new HSM_AET spirits in this bounded sidecar.
scope.status: Semantic briefs only; no image generation, export, approval, binding or gameplay edits.

art_direction.style: Painted HOI4/EaW national-spirit object icons. One dominant readable silhouette and no more than two supporting motifs. Target 64x64; transparent exterior, no enclosing scene panel.
art_direction.heraldry: The native neutral/democratic AET flag is horizontal black, white, cobalt with the exact joined black diamond device. Never invent a griffon coat of arms for Greifwald. Most briefs use thematic objects and no heraldry at all. The distinct fascist and communist flag devices must not be substituted for the county device.
art_direction.palette: Natural contextual materials determine color. Gold is permitted for actual brass/gilded highlights; it is not a universal wash. Maar-related effects may use restrained violet/cold light; research, agriculture, civic and military subjects retain distinct material palettes.
art_direction.negative_or_mixed: Show disruption or political cost through damaged objects, constrained arrangements and worn materials. Benefit/harm is not mechanically encoded as green/red. Native aggressive or oppressive ideology is depicted as game context, not endorsement.
art_direction.prohibitions: No humans, human hands, invented anatomical crests, generic lilies/crowns, blank seals/documents, pseudo-text, external-franchise insignia, gore or unrelated political symbols. Books and maps show meaningful diagrams. No per-family icon reuse implied.
art_direction.family_policy: All 38 exact idea definitions stay listed. Shared family is composition continuity for related stages, not permission to omit, merge or bind one image without review.

notes: AET_neutrality and AET_democratic: exact black/white/cobalt horizontal tricolor and joined diamond device.
AET_fascism: native white central device within blue/violet radiating form on black; copy actual reference only when specifically requested by brief.
AET_communism: native white anarchist composite device on black. Plain black pennants in briefs are deliberate avoidance of tiny complex heraldry.
GRI_neutrality: native black griffon on gold/orange field; do not substitute a white or gold griffon.
JER_democratic and CHN_fascism references are evidence of path-specific heraldry, not automatic motifs for every Aquileian/changeling subject.

families.direction: Maintain continuity while distinguishing the disruption-to-self-government transition.
Village clergy militia, organized Ebonwing paramilitary, then Maarite warriors: distinct silhouette and allegiance at every stage.

shared_picture_audit.scope_note: Counts are definition occurrences across source layers, not a resolved runtime idea count. All files parsed without error. Six representative external consumers per record are enough to prove unsafe global replacement; game-base consumers were not needed for that proof.
shared_picture_audit.rule: All 24 current picture keys have external consumers. Use new country-specific picture bindings; do not redefine their existing GFX sprite names or overwrite shared textures.

It is of the utmost importance that we maintain good relations with both. We cannot let Greifwald fall into the claws of extremists, as it is likely that such a change would put us on the path to war with one or more powers on the Griffonian continent.

Setting up work camps shall allow us to both kill them and get something out of them before the end. We shall also legalise every other kind of slavery to make sure there is always an underclass to exploit for Maar.

records.name: The Will of Maar

localized_description.en: The world shall kneel before the glory of Maar!

records.name: The Black Country

granting_focus_context.description_en: Our efforts to increase oil extraction have born fruit: Our oil industry is booming, and it doesn't show signs of stopping. It is believed that with increased funding, more synthetic oil can be produced. We will also be able to further expand the Adelart Oil Fields, and take advantage of any source that remains untapped. It is likely that the "Black Gold", as many griffons have named it, will continue to flow for many decades more.

If we can adapt an old blackpowder rifle for smokeless cartridges for half the cost of building a new rifle from scratch why not take it? If nothing else it should cut down on training time.

records.lore_notes: Preserve the native misspelled ID recylce. This is refurbishment of old rifles, not diplomacy despite its generic_flexible_foreign_policy2 placeholder.

records.name: Intellectual Haven

localized_description.en: The constant warfare which has plagued Griffonia for years has drawn many intellectuals to our little country due to our relative stability, and their contributions have increased our scientific base significantly. However an unfortunate side-effect of their residence is their nigh constant complaining.
localized_description.ru: Постоянная война, как большой гнойный нарыв на теле Грифонии, но благодаря тому, что у нас на протяжении многих лет царит мир и процветание к нам тянутся множество талантливых ученых. Однако статья расходов "На науку" растет с каждым днем...

granting_focus_context.description_en: Many scientists have taken up our offer of citizenship, but we can still improve upon this number. By granting significant subsidies to scientists and giving them more protection under the law, we can make Greifwald even more attractive to intelligent people looking for a safe haven.

records.lore_notes: English description emphasizes intellectuals complaining; Russian describes rising science spending. Both are preserved. The actual cost is political_power_cost = 0.30, not an explicit treasury mechanic.

And indeed, many of these bugs could be highly useful to the Greifwaldian nation. We should seek to set up ways to make it easier for "oppressed" Changelings to seek asylum in Greifwald. This will surely benefit our nation! After all, what could possibly go wrong?
